mainEntity.name: How long does a kitchen remodel typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a kitchen remodel depends on its complexity. A basic cosmetic refresh could take 2-4 weeks. A mid-range remodel involving new cabinets, countertops, and some appliance relocation usually spans 6-10 weeks. Extensive remodels with layout changes, plumbing, or electrical work might take 10-16 weeks or more. Factors like material availability and inspection schedules can also influence the timeline.
